response.sql: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT CENTROMEA AS status, AVG(HGB) AS average_hgb, AVG("T-BIL" / NULLIF(CRE, 0)) AS average_ratio FROM Laboratory WHERE "Date" > '1985-04-22' AND "Date" < '1994-03-14' GROUP BY CENTROMEA), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM status_averages) SELECT s.status, s.average_hgb, s.average_ratio, s.average_ratio / o.mean_ratio AS ratio_to_mean FROM status_averages AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.mean_ratio IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: The stored Date text uses the ISO format shown in the requested boundaries. The documentation also describes Date as YYMMDD.

alternatives.interpretation: If Date text is stored as YYMMDD, compare it with boundaries in that format.
